from semver import VersionInfo, replace

# Test R2: Iteration
v = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build.1')
print('R2 - Iteration:', list(v))

# Test R3: Tuple comparison
print('R3 - Equals tuple:', v == (1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build.1'))
print('R3 - Less than tuple:', v < (2, 0, 0, None, None))
print('R3 - Greater than tuple:', v > (1, 1, 2, 'beta', 'build.2'))
try:
    result = v == '1.2.3'
    print('R3 - String compare should return NotImplemented:', result)
except:
    print('R3 - String comparison raised exception')

# Test R4: Bump methods
v = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build.1')
print('R4 - bump_major:', v.bump_major())
print('R4 - bump_minor:', v.bump_minor())
print('R4 - bump_patch:', v.bump_patch())
print('R4 - bump_prerelease:', v.bump_prerelease())
print('R4 - bump_build:', v.bump_build())

# Test R5: Type conversion
v = VersionInfo('1', '2', '3', prerelease='alpha', build='build')
print('R5 - Types:', type(v.major), type(v.minor), type(v.patch), type(v.prerelease), type(v.build))

# Test R7: replace function and method
print('R7 - replace function:', replace('1.2.3-alpha+build', major=2))
print('R7 - replace method:', v.replace(major=5, minor=6))
"
